identification: Six unframed mounted works on paper (etchings/intaglio, monotype-style, photographic-style print), pencil signed Ryllton Viney '20 (indistinct). Tasmanian contemporary artist with a thin resale market. Armitage sold many Viney lots on 11 Nov 2026 for $5 to $105 each (small groups mostly $30 to $105), so this is a low-value lot.
